Camus taught it plainly: to freeze a thing, still its atoms; to destroy a thing, part them. Every technique you have ever thrown was this, and now you do it deliberately, with your hands, to anything at all.

  • Your unarmed Strikes ignore an object's Hardness entirely, and you can damage and destroy objects and structures of any material with your bare hands, including those normally immune to nonmagical damage.
  • Your unarmed Strikes and Techniques treat any creature's resistance to your damage as 5 lower. This stacks with, and applies before, Seventh Sense's resistance-ignoring.
  • You can affect a creature or object that is incorporeal, gaseous, liquid, or otherwise diffuse — a swarm, an air elemental, a creature in gaseous form — with your unarmed Strikes at no penalty, and such creatures do not gain their usual resistance to physical attacks against you.

Dissolve ◆◆ (two actions, concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Touch one unattended object of up to 10 Bulk, or a 10-foot cube of a structure. It is destroyed, its atoms parted and scattered as a fine glittering dust. This cannot destroy artifacts, Cloths, or objects of similar significance; against a creature's attended object, that creature may attempt a Reflex save against your Cosmo DC to pull it clear.

Special On any day your Cloth's constellation is ascendant or Exalted, Dissolve has no frequency limit and its size limit increases to 40 Bulk or a 20-foot cube.
